verdict.rationale: Ultrametric ships agent skill files, so a skill-authoring spec, template, or meta-skill would be a fair thing to expect, and the axis applies. The evidence only shows `ultrametric init` installing Ultrametric's own prebuilt SKILL.md into the .agents/.claude skill directories, plus templates for business-process guides. Nothing documents a spec, template, or meta-skill that lets an agent author and package a new skill.
